title: Clean return of the appender
statement: For every pair of Boolean words $x$ and $w$, there is a positive integer time $t$ with $t \le 2|w|+3|x|+6$ such that the appender, started on input $x$ with its work tape holding $w$ in the standard one-tape word assignment, is not halted at any time $v<t$, and at time $t$ is halted in exactly the configuration whose work tape holds $w$ followed by $x$, with the input head at its initial position, the work head at zero, and the output empty.
hypotheses_covered: the run is not halted at any time $v<t$
the configuration at time $t$ equals the specified halted configuration
replaced:
For every native input $x$ and existing word $w$ on the data tape, there is a
positive time $t \le 2|w| + 3|x| + 6$ such that the appender, started at its
canonical entry over the state word of $w$, is not halted before $t$ and at time
$t$ halts in the canonical configuration holding the state word of
$w \mathbin{+\!\!+} x$, with both the input and work heads returned to their
origins and no output.
